paragraphs.text: Meria is a young elven artificer from Yavimaya on Dominaria . Despite her age, she is the leader of the forest's elves .

Meria's light skin is dappled with gold around her bright, intelligent eyes. She wears a warrior's leather armor; scarlet, ochre, and orange. She has integrated repurposed Thran technology in that armor. Meria is an avid student of Dominaria's history. Unlike most Yavimayan elves, Meria is fascinated by the ancient technology left behind by the Thran and doesn't hesitate to wield it in Yavimaya's defense. While Meria is young by elven standards, her ingenuity, creativity, and curious approach to the world has proven the salvation of her people time and time again.

In 4562 AR , Jodah the Eternal traveled to Yavimaya to ask for the elves' support in the fight against the Second Phyrexian Invasion. Meria was hesitant to allow her warriors to abandon their homes for the cause, but shortly after the Yavimayans were attacked by Rona , piloting a dragon engine . Only the concerted efforts of Jonah and Meria, and their use of an old Thran Damping Sphere made it possible to defeat the Dragon Engine. After this foul attack, Meria pledged her people to the Coalition .
She led the Yavimayan forces at the Battle of the Mana Rig .
